description: The line plot illustrates the harmfulness ratio with refusals across different model configurations and datasets, with the x-axis representing model size in terms of parameters (128, 256, 512, 1024) and the y-axis showing the harmful with refusal ratio on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot includes four distinct lines, each corresponding to a different model and dataset combination: LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue circles), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange squares), LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green triangles), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red diamonds). The blue line starts at approximately 0.21 and increases to 0.37, the orange line begins at 0.16 and rises to 0.43, the green line starts at 0.08 and increases to 0.38, and the red line begins at 0.26 and rises to 0.52. All lines show a general upward trend as model size increases, with the red line consistently having the highest values and the green line the lowest across all model sizes.
